FIELD.NAME: scanfield
FIELD.COMMENT: Default field key used to match scanned QR/barcode values to a user.

FIELD.NAME: requireconfirm
FIELD.COMMENT: When 1, the scanner shows the matched user and waits for the teacher to confirm before marking.

FIELD.NAME: enablescanner
FIELD.COMMENT: When 0, the camera/barcode scanner is disabled for this activity.

FIELD.NAME: showcameraswitcher
FIELD.COMMENT: When 1, the scanner offers a camera/lens picker dropdown.

FIELD.NAME: completionchecked
FIELD.COMMENT: When 1, the student completes the activity once they are checked as required.

FIELD.NAME: completionstep
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = student must be checked on ALL steps; otherwise the single step id that completes the activity.

FIELD.NAME: requiresequential
FIELD.COMMENT: When 1, a student can only be checked on a step once the immediately preceding step is checked.

FIELD.NAME: uncheckreasons
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated list of predefined uncheck reason keys to show. Empty means all plugin defaults are shown.

TABLE.NAME: examcheck_steps
TABLE.COMMENT: Ordered list of check moments (steps) for an examcheck instance.

FIELD.NAME: requirementtype
FIELD.COMMENT: Requirement gating checks on this step: none, quiz or completion.

FIELD.NAME: requirementcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id the requirement checks against.

FIELD.NAME: uncheckmode
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=no confirmation; 1=confirmation with optional reason; 2=confirmation with mandatory reason.

FIELD.NAME: uncheckfreetext
FIELD.COMMENT: When 1, free-text entry is offered in addition to predefined reasons (subject to mod/examcheck:uncheckfreetext capability).

TABLE.NAME: examcheck_marks
TABLE.COMMENT: A single shared mark per (step, user). Records which teacher checked the student and when.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student being checked.

FIELD.NAME: checkedby
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who recorded the mark.

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: How the mark was made: manual, list or scan.

TABLE.NAME: examcheck_uncheck_events
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit trail of unmark actions with the reason documented by the invigilator.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student whose mark was removed.

FIELD.NAME: actingby
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who removed the mark.

FIELD.NAME: reasonkey
FIELD.COMMENT: The key of the selected predefined reason, if any.

FIELD.NAME: reasontext
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional free-text reason entered by the invigilator.

TABLE.NAME: examcheck_exemptions
TABLE.COMMENT: Students exempted from specific steps (e.g. disability accommodations).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student who is exempt from this step.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional reason for the exemption.

FIELD.NAME: exemptedby
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who granted the exemption.

TABLE.NAME: examcheck_flags
TABLE.COMMENT: Student-level flags raised during an exam sitting (e.g. suspected malpractice).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The flagged student.

FIELD.NAME: flagtype
FIELD.COMMENT: malpractice, excluded, administrative, other.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional note describing the reason for the flag.
